svg.text: Front view, to scale (rail 210 mm). All cables enter at the top. Field cables land on the top of X1, wires inside the box on the bottom. USB of the ESP32 stays reachable.
ESP32 header pins as mounted (RJ45 up, looking at the board from the front)
Pin 1 of EXT1 and EXT2 is now at the bottom. Pins with a coloured wire are used; grey pins stay free.
UEXT (10-pin box header, bottom of the board)
Pin 1 is the corner marked with a triangle on the connector.
The UEXT position on the board is drawn approximately.
Thick wires: solid or stranded with ferrules into terminals. Thin wires: Dupont leads, run in a bundle along the top (solder later for the final build).
Module terminals as printed by Waveshare: top VCC, GND, TXD, RXD; bottom SGND, A+, B− (isolated side).
meter bus A+ / B− from Box 2
+5 V / return to Finder coil in Box 2
relay coil; A2 is switched by Q1, never connect it to GND
Wall Connector bus; SGND is isolated, not common GND
EXT1 pin 1 / EXT1 pin 3 / EXT2 pin 10
